site.description: A free offline password manager for KeePass (KDBX) databases on Android and desktop.

hero.tagline: Your passwords. Your file. Your devices.
hero.text: A password manager for KeePass databases on Android and desktop - free, offline and open source.

privacy.title: Your vault never leaves you
privacy.text: No one between you and your passwords.

noData.title: Collects nothing
noData.text: No analytics, no telemetry. On Android - no network permission at all.

noAccount.title: No sign-up
noAccount.text: Install and use. No account, no email.

local.title: Stored on your devices
local.text: The database is a file you choose: phone, PC or a flash drive.

onlyYou.title: Only you have the key
onlyYou.text: Encrypted with your password and key file. Nobody else can open it.

compat.title: One file - many apps
compat.text: A standard KDBX 4 database: open the same file in the apps of the KeePass family.

generator.title: Password generator
generator.text: One tap on the dice - a strong password with a strength check.

keys.title: Password and key file
keys.text: Open a database with a password, a key file or both.

history.title: History and recycle bin
history.text: Changes are kept, deleted entries come back.

search.title: Search
search.text: Find any entry in a moment.

lock.title: Biometrics and auto-lock
lock.text: Fingerprint unlock on Android; locks itself when idle.

sync.title: Sync without a network
sync.text: Two copies of the database come together right on the device - no cloud in between.

download.title: Get {app}
download.text: Free - for Android and desktop. The files are taken straight from GitHub Releases.

warning.title: The system will warn you - that is expected
warning.text: Installers are not signed yet: signing licenses cost money. Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper will show a warning - the code is open, you can check it.

open.title: All the code is open
open.text: Read it, build it, check it.

app.title: The app
app.text: Android and desktop - Kotlin, Compose Multiplatform.

issues.title: Found a bug?
issues.text: Describe it in Issues - it helps a lot.

open.disclaimer: Provided as is, without warranty (GPL-3.0). Keep a backup of your database.

support.title: Free - and it stays free
support.text: Donations pay for the licenses: code signing and the stores. Then the warnings go away.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: There is no such page. It may have moved.

download.noStable: No stable version yet - test builds are on the releases page.

verify.title: How to check a file
verify.text: Compute SHA-256 of the downloaded file and compare it with the one under its button - they must match.
verify.apk: The APK is signed with our certificate. Its SHA-256 - check with apksigner (Android SDK): a different one means the file is not ours.
verify.attestation: Every file has a build attestation - proof that GitHub Actions built it from the source code:

obtainium.text: Updates on their own - via Obtainium.
